fieldValues.title: A synthesis stage is expressible; a computed field is not
fieldValues.summary: A two-stage Protocol over the LiveWyer Insight report's own types clustered 417 real findings into 32 problems with 353 evidence links in one stage; asked to set the computed signal field in the next, the model marked all eleven opportunities strong.
evidence: insight-synthesis on a copy of livewyer-insight, 2026-11-27: stage 1 accepted first time; 18 of 32 problems match one of the original 23 at Jaccard 0.3 or more
Original signal: computed from distinct conference series by tools/link.py
fieldValues.body: Grouping with links arriving from the grouped records fits today's Protocol. Counting, ranking and rendering need a compute stage; a loop over 361 talks needs for-each; the affirmation queue needs a gate.
